name: 演示文稿
description: 在 IDE 里打开和编辑 PowerPoint（.pptx）：按原样式显示幻灯片，可以改文字、移动和缩放形状、插入文本框 / 形状 / 图片 / 表格，增删、复制、拖动排序幻灯片，编辑备注，全屏放映。保存的文件可以直接用 PowerPoint 打开。IDE 里的 AI 助手可以读取幻灯片、按版式新建幻灯片、改文字和排版。

agentTools.name: getSlides
agentTools.description: Read the presentation: slide size, available layouts, and for every slide its layout, speaker notes and shapes — each shape with its id, name, kind (textbox, shape, picture, table, line, group, chart/diagram), placeholder role (title, subtitle, body…), position and size in pt, and its text (tables: cells). Shape ids or placeholder roles are used by the other tools.

agentTools.name: addSlide
agentTools.description: Add a slide based on one of the presentation's layouts (see the layouts list in pptx_getSlides; default: "Title and Content", or the title layout for the first slide) and fill its placeholders. Body text: one paragraph per line; indent a line with 2 spaces per level for sub-bullets — bullets come from the layout, so do not type "-" yourself. A new empty .pptx file path creates a blank presentation first.

position.description: Slide number the new slide gets. Default: at the end.

layout.description: Layout name or type, e.g. "Title Slide", "title", "obj", "Two Content", "Title Only", "Blank", or its number in the list.

body.description: Text of the first content placeholder.

agentTools.name: editSlides
agentTools.description: Delete, duplicate, hide / show slides, or move one slide to another position.

to.description: move: the slide number it should end up with.

agentTools.name: setText
agentTools.description: Replace the text of a shape or placeholder and / or format all of its text. One paragraph per line; 2 leading spaces per indent level. For tables pass `cells` (rows of cell texts; rows and columns are added when needed). Formatting keeps the current style unless given: size (pt), bold, italic, underline, color (#rrggbb), align (left, center, right, justify), verticalAlign (top, middle, bottom).

shape.description: Shape id, shape name, or placeholder role: title, subtitle, body, body:2 …

agentTools.name: addShape
agentTools.description: Insert something on a slide. kind: textbox {text}; shape {geometry: a preset like rect, roundRect, ellipse, triangle, diamond, rightArrow, chevron, star5, wedgeRectCallout, flowChartDecision…, text}; line / arrow {x1, y1, x2, y2}; image {path: image file relative to the workspace root; give w or h to keep the aspect ratio}; table {rows, cols, cells}. Position and size (x, y, w, h) in pt; centered by default. Optional fill, line (#rrggbb or "none"), lineWidth (pt) and text formatting (size, bold, italic, color, align).

agentTools.name: editShape
agentTools.description: Move, resize or rotate a shape (x, y, w, h in pt, rotation in degrees), change its fill / outline color (#rrggbb or "none") and outline width, change the stacking order (front, back, forward, backward), or delete it.

shape.description: Shape id, name, or placeholder role.

agentTools.name: setNotes
agentTools.description: Replace the speaker notes of a slide.

agentTools.name: screenshot
agentTools.description: Pass `slide` to show that slide first (default: the current slide).
